name: Toxic Test
summary: Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater asks you to test the Devilsaur Barb on a devilsaur. Return to him once you have done so.

sections.title: The Barb
sections.body: With the Devilsaur Barb in hand, you have a way to test it. Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater awaits your return after you stab a devilsaur; the test rests on that strike.

faq.q: What does Torwa want me to do?
faq.answer: Torwa Pathfinder asks you to stab a devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb, then return to him in Un'Goro Crater.
Return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater after stabbing a devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb.

faq.q: What do I use on the devilsaur?
faq.answer: Use the Devilsaur Barb to stab a devilsaur.
